communication_goal: 发现反复试错时暂停修改、交接证据。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE polished educational scene illustration, square canvas approximately 1024x1024. Pure solid BLACK background with crisp clean WHITE line art only. Minimalist adult stick-figure programmer with circular head, thin limbs and simple expressive face. The programmer is conversing with a recognizable official OpenAI six-loop interwoven knot logo floating nearby, drawn in white with black negative spaces; the logo itself represents the AI conversational partner and has no human body. EXACTLY ONE human programmer and ONE OpenAI logo. Single coherent scene, no panels. Restrained programmer comic aesthetic. Keep the main scene approximately x=180..820 and y=230..770 on a 0..1000 canvas. Leave generous empty black space at the top y<200 and bottom y>820 for later learning labels. Props named in the scene must be recognizable, complete and unobstructed. No colored elements, gradients, gray shading, photorealism, textures, glow. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, readable code, captions, watermark or other logos. The only brand symbol is the requested OpenAI knot. Scene: The adult stick-figure programmer stands at left of a desk and raises one open palm toward the floating OpenAI knot at right to pause the discussion. A large standalone computer keyboard lies fully visible in front of a simple desktop monitor. Draw the keyboard as a clean rectangular object with several rows of small blank outlined keys, no letters or numbers. Keep hands away from the keyboard so all edges remain visible. The monitor is blank. The keyboard is the main visible learning prop.

coverage_review.scope: V004 的逐词编辑与底图视觉核对完成；本专题其他计划卡未制作，不声称学习效果或手机端验收。

annotation_coordinate_system: [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]，左上角为原点，按最终 images/V004.png 宽高归一化至 0..1；由人工视觉定位。

image_review.summary: 通过：黑底白线单幅插画，一个成年火柴人和一个可辨认的白色 OpenAI 六环结标识，底图无对白文字。键盘完整、按键无文字，画面抬手仅作暂停的情境表达，不宣称系统停止。
